attributes.notes:
Today's plan introduces long division and continues practice on sorting, receptive language, and requesting with full sentences. The afternoon includes art and social skills practice.
[Progression] This plan builds on yesterday's activities by introducing a new math concept (long division) and slightly varying the objects used for sorting. It maintains the structure of the previous day's schedule.

scheduleItems.activity: DI Math: Introduction to Long Division with 3-digit numbers. Use manipulatives to represent the process. Use ABLLS-R C4 materials.
Sorting: Sort non-identical objects into 3 categories (e.g., fruits, vegetables, furniture) for 10 minutes. Use ABLLS-R B12 materials.
sensory break (short movement or calming activity)
Receptive Language: Present 5 common objects (e.g., cup, shoe, ball, book, spoon) and ask Jamie to identify each by pointing. Use ABLLS-R C8 materials.
Science/Social Studies: Group circle time, introduce topic of 'animals' with picture cards.
Specials: Art class with Ms. Johnson
Social Skills: Requesting with Full Sentences during free choice. Prompt Jamie to use 'I want ____' when requesting toys or activities.
